name: mux-factory-board
description: Local board for the Mux factory: reads the Mux GitHub Project through gh and shows it as a board.

scripts.dev: vp build && { vp build --watch --clearScreen false & trap 'kill $!' EXIT; node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --watch --watch-path=src --watch-path=dist src/server.ts; }
scripts.test: vp build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test "test/*.test.ts" && vp test run
scripts.sample: vp build && BOARD_DATA_FILE=test/sample.json T3_SETTINGS=test/t3-settings.sample.json T3_MODEL_MANIFEST=test/model-manifest.sample.json node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/server.ts
